In addition to the requirements in <Guidance Notes on Registration of Pharmaceutical Products: 
New Drug Applications>, applicants are required to provide the following additional documents for 
NDAs of ATPs: 
(a) site master file(s), or equivalent, of the proposed production site(s) or facility(ies), including 
the methods, standards and conditions of the manufacture of the ATP, the manufacturing 
and quality control facilities, technical personnel, etc, for NDA of an ATP manufactured 
outside Hong Kong; 
(b) one set of prototype sales pack for each applied pack size of the product, which should 
comply with the labelling requirements specified in <Guidelines on the Labelling of 
Pharmaceutical Products> and <Guidance on Labelling Requirements of Product Code, 
Unique Donation Identifier and Unique Recipient Identifier for Advanced Therapy 
Products>, of which the label should contain product code and unique donation identifier.  
For autologous product, unique recipient identifier is also required. The coding systems 
adopted should be specified; 
(c) ICH CTD Modules 2 to 5. The specific requirements for each type of ATPs are outlined in 
the Appendices 1 to 3; 
(d) a description of the traceability system that the Registration Certificate holder intends to 
establish and maintain to ensure that the individual product and its starting and raw materials, 
including all substances coming into contact with the cells or tissues it may contain, can be 
traced through the sourcing, manufacturing, packaging, storage, transport and delivery to 
the hospital, institution or private healthcare facilities where the product is used; 
(e) strategy to evaluate long-term efficacy;

Requirements for Pharmaceuticals for Human Use (“ICH”). These organisation and format are 
described in ICH M4(R4), M4Q(R1), M4S(R2), and M4E(R2). The dossier should be 
complete and up-to-date. To ensure traceability, it is recommended to assign unique document 
and version numbers to each document.

requirements), should be submitted in ONE DVD or blu-ray disc. Modules should be 
organised in folders and subfolders according to the chronology and titles specified in ICH 
M4(R4). To facilitate navigation through the dossier, bookmarks, a table of content (if 
appropriate), and reference hyperlinks to other documents should be included.11

contraindications, and adverse effects in the package inserts authorized in other 
countries/places, with justifications for any differences; and

of at least one of the countries / places listed in Table 2, to substantiate the content
